item.text: The initial screening found promising BCC strut cells, but their uncertainty ranges cross the requirements. The search is looking for more margin before certification.

The search found a BCC candidate with nominal solid fraction 18.9%, C44 of 20.5 MPa, and a predicted complete gap covering the requested interval. Certification is now checking those estimates with finer resolutions and full Brillouin-zone coverage.
Certification is still running. Its error bounds will determine whether the candidate’s stiffness and gap meet the targets.
The tool has not returned a verdict yet. I’m waiting for the certificate before deciding whether this design can be released.
Certification remains in progress. The tool reports a typical runtime of 2–20 minutes for these checks.

item.text: Released a certified 12 mm PA12 BCC cell with node radius 3.273864 mm and strut radius 0.569724 mm. It meets all targets: solid fraction ≤18.86%, C44 ≥17.62 MPa, and a complete elastic band gap covering 33.7–39.3 kHz. SLS manufacturability was not evaluated.
